references.text: God is merciful and forgives us, just as we are also to forgive others.
The Lord forgives our wrongdoings and does not remember our sins; this is an encouragement to forgive others.
An encouragement not to judge or condemn, but to forgive, so that we ourselves may be forgiven.
We must forgive the one who sins against us, even if it happens many times.
Judgment will be without mercy for those who have shown no mercy; mercy triumphs over judgment.
